SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN a.published_version_id IS NULL THEN a.create_time ELSE COALESCE(a.publish_time, a.create_time) END AS display_time FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.user_id = #{userId}
AND a.published_version_id IS NOT NULL
AND a.published_version_id IS NULL
AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article_version WHERE id = a.latest_version_id AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')) OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
